The '''Greater Coruscant University''' was a [[University/Legends|university]] located on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Thalleus Tharn]] served as the University's [[chair of xenopsychiatric medicine]] in [[44 ABY]].
